params.rate_desc: Graduated brackets from 2.0% to 5.0%. Standard deduction uses the Form 40 maximum ($3,000 single / $8,500 joint for 2022+; $2,500 single / $7,500 joint for 2019-2021); the AGI phase-down chart is not modeled. Personal exemption $1,500 single / $3,000 joint. The federal income tax deduction and dependent exemption are not modeled. Tax year 2018 uses the 2022 Form 40 standard-deduction maximum as an estimate (the archived 2018 Form 40 states the personal exemption but not the standard-deduction chart).
